lead_raw_text:
The structure of Zn6Cr2Se8 (reduced formula Zn3CrSe4) crystallizes in the tetragonal space group I-4m2 (No. 119), with 16 atoms per unit cell distributed over five independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Cr centers coordinated by four Se neighbors at 2.31–2.45 Å, while Zn centers adopt two distinct four-neighbor Se environments. The Se environments include tetrahedral motifs, and validated polyhedron contacts reveal corner-sharing between Se tetrahedra and between Cr and Se four-vertex polyhedra, with the neighbor graph forming a single three-dimensional component.
